tool_args.rationale: The five fixed-context observations are insufficient to distinguish a saturating snapshot law from the indicated mobility-bridge siphon readout. The open-branch probe directly targets that ambiguity at lower cost than a fine trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations show clear saturation, but the bridge-epidemic signature and temporal before/after readout leave a competing mechanism unidentified.
At fixed x_now, this predicts a linear dependence on u_now, inconsistent with the observed curvature.
An open-branch discriminating measurement is a more direct, lower-cost test of the unresolved bridge mechanism.
It is irrelevant to the identified mechanism ambiguity and has unnecessary cost.
